background.brief: Supply chain weekly sync: round of updates

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Okay, let's start. Samir, you want to go first since you've got the most open lines?

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: sure. um, can everyone see my screen? the tracker

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Yep, we see it

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: ok so top of the list is machined parts for the leg build, most of those are confirmed, i've got two vendors who haven't sent ship confirmation yet so i'm chasing those today

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Chasing by email or phone?

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: email first, phone tmrw if i don't hear back. one of them is usually just slow on paperwork

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: I think one of those is the one with the anodize going outside? Not 100% sure, but if it is, that's probably where the time goes.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: yeah could be, i'll ask

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: next one, 21700 cells for test packs. that moved, it's 10/15 now. was supposed to be last week. they're saying 10/15, i'd treat that as soft

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: You're asking whether that hurts the build. It doesn't touch the leg build directly, the test packs are a test lab thing, but I'd want Dmitri to know.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: i'll ping him after

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Do we have any cells on the shelf at all?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Some, from the last pack build. I'd have to count. I'll check this afternoon

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Please do. And check the storage, I want to make sure they're in the flammables cabinet and not on a rack.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: They are, I moved them myself

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Talia, fasteners and consumables?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Fasteners are mostly restocked. The kanban bins for the small socket heads keep running out faster than the card says, I think the min is set too low

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: That matches what I see on the floor. The techs are grabbing from the bin and not pulling the card.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Ugh. Okay, I'll bump the min and remind people about the cards

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Maybe tape the card to the bin? Probably low-tech but it might work

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Honestly yes

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: On the build side, you're asking what's still not kitted. So, one, a few machined parts that Samir already covered; two, the harness sub-kits, which are in progress; three, adhesives, which I want to double check for shelf life before we kit them.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Good call on the adhesives. We had expired epoxy in a kit once and nobody noticed until it didn't cure.

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Was that the foot bonding? I think that might be what Destiny's seeing, the voids. Not sure though.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: I'll check the lot on that. Could be technique too.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: one more thing, the quoting portal was down for like half of friday, so a couple of quotes i expected didn't come back. resubmitted this morning

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Fine. Flag it if anything's still missing by Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: will do. wed. well, thurs at the latest

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Kind of unrelated, but did anyone else get the email about the parking lot repaving?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Yes, ugh, we're all parking on the street apparently

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Let's not get into parking. Anything else on the tracker?

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: no that's it from me

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Okay. Thanks everyone.
